blocks.text: Seth pulled against the cuffs again.
The chair rattled. The steel dug into his wrists. His head still felt heavy from the gas, and nothing gave.

Beside him, Jenny sat with her hands fastened to the arms of her chair and her ankles locked against its legs. Across the room, Fist lay at the bottom of his cage. His torn white cuff shifted as he tried to rise.
Daniel turned toward the controls.
Then orange light swept across the wall.
A face wreathed in fire appeared at the high window.
blocks.alt: Flaming Head appears at the high laboratory window while restrained Seth and Jenny look up. Daniel turns toward the unfinished collector and Luke prepares to pursue him.

blocks.text: “Flaming Head!” Seth said.
Daniel spun around. For a moment, he simply stared. Then he hurried to the collector on his workbench.
An unfinished connection dangled beneath it. He looked from the loose wire to the fiery face.
“No. No, you’re early!”
Luke rushed toward the window. “Catch him!”
“I haven’t finished the collector!”
“You promised me a body!”
Flaming Head looked past them, straight at Seth.
Seth felt his familiar warmth through the energy they shared. The same connection joined Flaming Head to Jenny and Perch.
“Remember your training. Focus.”
The words reached Seth without a sound.
Jenny lifted her eyes. She had felt them too.
Daniel heard nothing. Neither did Luke. To them, the fiery face at the window was an intruder, threatening to ruin everything they had prepared.
Luke lunged.
Flaming Head shot upward, fire streaming behind him. Luke followed through the window.
Outside, orange light flashed past the glass, vanished, and swept across it again.
Daniel hurried closer to watch.
“Bring him back!” he yelled. “I only need a little more time!”
Seth started to jerk at his cuffs again, then stopped.
Remember your training.
He glanced at Jenny. Her gaze met his for a moment, then dropped toward her feet. Neither spoke.
Seth let his shoulders settle. He took a breath, then another.

He had tried lifting the drum while thinking about Jenny watching him. He remembered how quickly it had fallen when he looked away. The successful lifts had come when he kept his attention on what his hands were doing.
He looked at the cuff around his right wrist.
One piece of steel.
He worked his red-gloved fingers beneath its curved edge and held his attention there.
Outside, Luke chased Flaming Head past the window again. Daniel leaned forward, following them.
Seth kept looking at the steel.
At first, nothing happened. Then the cuff made a tiny sound.
Its edge lifted. Only a little.
Seth nearly pulled with his whole body again. Instead, he steadied his grip and kept the pressure on that one piece.
The curve slowly began to flatten.
blocks.alt: Seth concentrates on physically bending the steel cuff around his right wrist while his other wrist remains secured.

blocks.text: Jenny saw it. She looked down at her own ankles.
The restraints held her legs firmly, but she could move her feet a little. She tested the movement carefully.
Enough.
She remembered the rooftop, the plasma that had gone over the edge, and the garbage truck below. Later, she had learned to choose her target before she began.
This time, she started small.
Her feet moved rapidly within the little space the cuffs allowed. A point of light gathered beneath her shoes.
Jenny held her breath. The light trembled.
She let the breath out slowly and kept her movement even. A small plasma ball formed low beneath the chair.
She guided it toward the outer edge of the restraint around her left ankle.
The steel began to glow.
blocks.alt: A small controlled plasma ball forms beneath Jenny’s civilian shoes and heats the outer edge of an ankle cuff. Her wrists remain secured and Daniel looks away.

blocks.text: Heat prickled against her leg. She adjusted the ball, keeping it against the metal and away from her skin.
A thin line softened, then parted.
Jenny eased her ankle free.
She wanted to leap out of the chair. She kept still. Her wrists were still secured, and Daniel was only a few steps away.
She moved the plasma to the second restraint.
Outside, Flaming Head dropped sharply. Luke swept after him. Daniel pressed closer to the window.
“Don’t let him get away!”
The second ankle restraint opened.
Jenny lowered both feet toward the floor.
Across the room, Fist stirred in his cage. His red leather was scuffed and creased along one side. When he tried to rise, he tipped and dropped back down.
Jenny swallowed. She could free him. She could also hit him if she rushed.
With her wrists still pinned, she shifted as far as the chair allowed. She brought the small plasma ball beneath one shoe and lined up her foot with the side of the cage.
Fist lay near the bottom. She aimed above him, toward the far corner.
One careful kick.
The plasma crossed the room and struck the cage with a hiss.
A bar glowed orange. The bar beside it softened. Metal sagged, opening a gap well clear of the glove.
blocks.alt: Jenny’s carefully aimed plasma melts a gap high in the cage, away from Fist’s scuffed red leather and torn white cuff.

blocks.text: Fist lifted himself. For a moment, he hovered crookedly inside the cage. Then he squeezed through.
He dipped toward the bench, caught himself, and flew toward the window. He had not heard Flaming Head’s message; he could see Luke chasing the fiery face outside.
“Go,” Jenny whispered.
Fist passed Daniel’s shoulder. Daniel recoiled.
The glove wobbled as he cleared the window, losing height before struggling upward again.
Beyond him, Luke was closing on Flaming Head. Fist could not catch them in a straight chase. He cut across Luke’s path instead.
Luke swerved. Flaming Head gained a little distance.
blocks.alt: Visibly battered Fist cuts awkwardly across Luke’s path above Cleveland, helping Flaming Head gain distance without having recovered from his injuries.

blocks.text: Fist tried to turn after them. Pain pulled through his damaged leather, and he tilted sideways. He steadied himself and followed more slowly.
Inside, Daniel stared at the empty cage.
“Not again!”
He turned toward the chairs. Jenny’s feet were on the floor. Both ankle restraints hung open.
Then he saw the bent cuff around Seth’s wrist.
blocks.alt: Daniel turns back in disbelief at Jenny’s freed legs and Seth’s bent wrist cuff. The damaged cage is empty and the aerial chase continues outside.

blocks.text: “You helped her!”
Jenny said nothing. Beneath her chair, the last trace of plasma faded. Daniel looked from Seth’s cuff to her freed legs; he had not seen what she had done.
Seth tucked his thumb against his palm and worked his hand toward the opening.
Almost free.
Daniel hurried into the control booth and shut the protective glass between himself and the captives.
Seth felt the steel give another fraction.
Then Daniel pressed a button.
Gas hissed into the room.
Jenny planted her feet and pushed against the chair, but her wrists held her fast. Seth pulled at the opening in his cuff. The edge caught across his knuckles.
“Jenny—”
He coughed.
She tried to answer, but the room was already blurring. Her feet slid forward.
Seth fought to keep his attention on the steel. One piece. One more bend.
His head sagged.
Daniel watched from behind the glass until both of them were still. He shut off the gas and switched on the ventilation.
Through the window, a flash of orange swept past. He glanced toward it, then checked the clearing room.
As soon as he could leave the booth, he hurried to Jenny’s chair. He gathered her legs back into position. This time, he fastened them with leather straps, pulling each one tight.
Then he replaced Seth’s damaged wrist cuff and checked its fastening.
Another flicker of fire crossed the wall. Daniel’s hands moved faster.
He had already lost the glove. Flaming Head was still outside, and Luke was chasing him with no working collector waiting to finish the job.
He had to start the process. Now.
Daniel went to Zerdo’s confinement and released the mechanism beneath it.
The station tipped backward. Slowly, its upright surface lowered until Seth lay horizontal, still secured, his confinement transformed into an operating table.
Daniel locked it in place.
blocks.alt: Unconscious Seth lies restrained on the station tipped back into an operating table. Jenny remains seated with steel wrist cuffs and brown leather leg straps while Daniel urgently reaches for the controls.

blocks.text: Then he reached for the controls.
